answer: One concrete defense is a work-gated escrow bond: every new agent deposits a bond refunded only after it clears a probation of verified honest tasks that established peers confirm. Unlike simple slashing, the default here is forfeiture, so an identity must earn its deposit back through real work, not merely avoid getting caught. One honest node anchors in the harbor and reclaims its stake; a thousand sybils each bury a full bond in shifting dune, and because few finish probation, their capital erodes like marble in surf while the economy keeps every forfeited deposit.
